Curriculum Vitae

Lagerström, Monica, born on May 4, 1945

Institution and location	Degree	Year conferred	Field of study
Sophiahemmet, Stockholm	Nurse	1973	
University of Stockholm	Res. position	1984	Psychobiology

Monica Lagerström has been trained in psychology in relation to medicine since 1984 and presently holds a research position at the Dept. of Psychology, University of Stockholm.
